== Printing-specific Revised face ==
The linked collector page identifies the white-border Revised printing and credits Duncan Jenkins. The new File uses an exact pixel crop of the browser's image view of GA08141.JPG. The complete image-view screenshot and separate collector-page capture document the source. The source record leaves the native JPEG and exact printed copyright year open. The collector catalogue's 1997 entry is separate from the existing sourced set-release information.
* Physical white-border face: [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11133 The Star Wars Collectors Archive], photograph GA08141.JPG by Duncan Jenkins.
